question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
SELECT 
    ph.product_id,
    ph.page_name,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS views,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS added_to_cart,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS actual_purchases,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS left_in_cart_without_purchase
FROM shopping_cart_events e
LEFT JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON e.page_id = ph.page_id
WHERE e.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
GROUP BY ph.product_id, ph.page_name
ORDER BY ph.product_id
